persona: Mid-level payments fraud analyst at a fintech
resumeText:
Ananya Rao | Bengaluru | ananya.rao@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Fraud Analyst, Kavach Pay Solutions, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Tuned 40 card and UPI fraud rules in the real-time fraud monitoring tool, cutting false declines on good customers.
- Reviewed daily fraud alerts on flagged merchant accounts and closed each case with notes.
- Used device fingerprinting and velocity checks to link mule accounts across UPI handles.
- Wrote SQL queries on transaction tables to trace account takeover patterns.
- Built a weekly fraud loss dashboard in Tableau for the risk head.
- Shared monthly fraud trend notes with product and operations teams.
- Worked with partner banks and the cyber cell to freeze funds on reported scam cases.

Payment Operations Analyst, Setu Ledger Services, Pune (2020 - 2022)
- Reconciled failed UPI and IMPS payments with partner banks every day.
- Analysed settlement exceptions in Excel pivot tables for the finance team.

EDUCATION
BCom, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2020

SKILLS
SQL, Excel, Tableau, Chargebacks, Python
